title: Katanya
mood: wry and scolding, a sisterly telling-off
subject: the neighbourhood WhatsApp group forwarding a warning about a kidnapper disguised as a balloon seller, and the whole street chasing Pak Udin, who has sold balloons there for twenty years
caption: Qasidah modern in the Semarang orkes style of the 1980s, the Nasida Ria lineage. Rebana and terbang frame drums in interlocking patterns over a light, steady kit backbeat with tambourine; a violin playing the main melody with Middle Eastern-flavoured runs; a suling flute answering between lines; a combo organ holding the chords; clean electric guitar and bass in a simple orkes groove. Lightly produced and a little roomy, the voices and rebana forward, the violin bright on top. An all-female vocal group singing in unison and two-part harmony, alternating with one clear female solo lead who tells the story in plain Indonesian. 112 BPM, D minor. Wry and scolding, a sisterly telling-off. No solo devotional pop, no Arabic chanting, no dangdut gendang groove, no mandolin, no male lead, no EDM, no rock guitar solo, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - violin melody over interlocking rebana]

[Verse 1 - solo lead]
Jam sembilan malam di grup RT
Masuk pesan, diteruskan berkali-kali
"Awas, penculik menyamar jadi tukang balon
Sebarkan ke semua grup, demi anak-anak kita"

[Pre-Chorus - group in harmony]
Nggak ada nama, nggak ada foto
Tapi semua langsung kirim lagi

[Chorus - group in unison]
Katanya, katanya, dari grup sebelah
Grup sebelah katanya dari grup lain
Siapa yang nulis, nggak ada yang tahu
Tapi jempol kita cepat sekali

[Verse 2 - solo lead]
Besok sorenya Pak Udin lewat bawa balon
Dua puluh tahun dia jualan di gang ini
Satu RT keluar, ada yang bawa sapu
Ada yang lari sambil bikin video

[Chorus - group in unison]
Katanya, katanya, dari grup sebelah
Grup sebelah katanya dari grup lain
Siapa yang nulis, nggak ada yang tahu
Tapi Pak Udin yang dikejar satu gang

[Bridge - solo lead over the rebana alone]
Pak Udin duduk di trotoar, ngos-ngosan
Balonnya lepas, nyangkut di kabel listrik
Besoknya Bu RT beli sepuluh balon
Minta maaf, bayarnya dilebihin
Tapi pesan yang kemarin itu
Masih jalan terus di grup lain

[Outro - group, the violin plays the last phrase]
Katanya, katanya, dari grup sebelah
Tabayyun dulu, baru kirim
